result.summary: The page is visually clean overall, with only one minor content anomaly: a discount badge showing an effectively meaningless 0% discount.

issues.description: The discount badge on the partially visible pizza restaurant card displays '-0%', which is a meaningless or incorrect discount value.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0%, or fix the data/logic so it shows a real positive percentage (e.g., '-20%').
